## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link R/F/scenario IDs and the OpenSpec change when applicable. Small nonbehavioral fixes and compatible recipe additions do not need a full change.

## Verification

State the actual commands/results, the defect a new test detects, and relevant failure cases. Separate planned, skipped and executed checks; do not copy legacy tests solely for coverage counts.

## Compatibility and data

Note applicable migration/rollback, credential/tenant/effect boundaries, package compatibility/license, and any unsupported behavior. Omit this section if irrelevant. Never attach real credentials, conversations or vault data.
